use codegen_runtime::{ExecutionContext, Instance, InvocationCounterLimits, ScopeContext, Value};
use serde_json::{Value as Json, json};

fn plain(value: &Instance) -> Json {
    match value {
        Instance::Group(fields) => Json::Object(
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| (key.clone(), plain(value)))
                .collect(),
        ),
        Instance::Repeated(items) | Instance::MappedSequence(items) => {
            Json::Array(items.iter().map(plain).collect())
        }
        Instance::Scalar(Value::String(value)) => json!(value),
        Instance::Scalar(Value::Bool(value)) => json!(value),
        Instance::Scalar(Value::Null) => Json::Null,
        _ => panic!("unexpected native output kind"),
    }
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::args().nth(1).ok_or("need input path")?);
    let physical =
        mfd051_native_nullable_r4::parse_native_primary_x12_source(&std::fs::read(&path)?)?;
    let execution = ExecutionContext::new(std::path::Path::new("neutral.mfd"))
        .with_invocation_counter_limits(InvocationCounterLimits {
            max_counters: 4,
            max_text_bytes: 1024,
        });
    let root = ScopeContext::with_execution_context(&physical, &execution);
    let body_clock = || Ok("2026-10-24T12:00:00".to_string());
    let filename_clock = || Ok("2026-10-25T13:00:00".to_string());
    assert!(
        mfd051_native_nullable_r4::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
            &root,
            Some(&body_clock),
            Some(&filename_clock)
        )
        .is_err()
    );
    let mut actual = Vec::new();
    for message in root.walk_source(&["Interchange", "Group", "Message_850"]) {
        assert!(matches!(
            message.source_root_field(9000, &["BEG", "F1"])?,
            Value::Null
        ));
        let document = mfd051_native_nullable_r4::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
            &message,
            Some(&body_clock),
            Some(&filename_clock),
        )?
        .ok_or("missing output document")?;
        actual.push(json!({"path":document.path(),"value":plain(document.value())}));
        for row in message.walk_source(&["Rows"]) {
            assert!(
                mfd051_native_nullable_r4::prepare_native_x12_nullable_message(
                    &row,
                    Some(&body_clock),
                    Some(&filename_clock)
                )
                .is_err()
            );
        }
        assert!(matches!(
            message.source_root_field(9000, &["BEG", "F1"])?,
            Value::Null
        ));
    }
    let expected: Json =
        serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(path.with_file_name("expected.json"))?)?;
    let actual = json!(actual);
    std::fs::write(
        path.with_extension("rust-native-results.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({"actual":actual,"expected":expected}))?,
    )?;
    if actual != expected {
        return Err(format!("native selected-message mismatch: {actual}").into());
    }
    println!(
        "3 selected-message native entries; root isolation, four counter rows and both clocks passed"
    );
    Ok(())
}
